TERMS AND CONDITIONS

By accepting these Terms and Conditions or by accepting any of the benefits provided via the Intel Deal Registration system (“System”), you will be confirming that your Company has authorized you to enter into these Terms and Conditions with Intel, on behalf of your Company, and that your Company agrees to enter into these Terms and Conditions with Intel.

Introduction

The System provides You with a convenient tool to register end customer deals with Intel and to obtain supporting benefits from Intel to assist you in selling to that customer. The provision of benefits is determined solely at the discretion of Intel’s Sales and Marketing Organization, and is subject to these Terms and Conditions and the terms contained in the individual quote letter describing the benefits offered for a particular deal (“Quote Letter”) which may take the form of a rebate, or other non-financial benefits.

1.    Deal Entry. You are responsible for entering a new deal which You are pursuing (“Entered Deal”), according to instructions in the System. Information that will be provided about the Entered Deal includes, but is not limited to, the name of the end customer, the Intel products involved, a detailed Entered Deal description, and defined Entered Deal start and end dates, as well as the name of the relevant OEM, the name of the partners’ competitor and the product they are offering as well as the name of the OEM underlying the partner’s product offering.  

2.    Email Notification of Approval and Benefits Provided. You will be notified by the System administration, via a system generated email, when an Entered Deal is approved, and becomes an Approved Opportunity. You will receive a Quote Letter, describing the benefits, financial or otherwise, which Intel will provide to You to support Your Approved Opportunity. No other communication, written or verbal, constitutes approval including discussion or communication with any Intel Employee. Benefits will be provided pursuant to the terms of that Quote Letter, which will provide specifics regarding products, customer, project, and dates, on which the provided benefit will be conditional. Failure to abide by these Terms and Conditions or the terms of the Quote Letter will result in denial of benefits. 

3.     Modifications. Benefits provided can be modified, changed, or terminated at Intel’s discretion, upon the delivery of a new, updated Quote Letter. You may request modifications to the Approved Opportunity, and Intel may accept these modifications or changes, in its sole discretion. If a modification or termination is accepted, an updated Quote Letter will be provided to You.  

4.    Approved Opportunity Win/Loss. You are responsible to communicate whether you have won or lost a particular Approved Opportunity, via the System. You must provide proof of performance, as instructed by the System.    

5.    Confidentiality. You are required to keep these Terms and Conditions, the terms and conditions of the Quote Letter, and all benefits provided confidential, subject to Your Corporate Non-Disclosure Agreement (CNDA) with Intel, or the confidentiality obligations of the Terms and Conditions of the Intel Partner Alliance, as appropriate.

6.    Program Rights Reserved. Intel reserves the right to alter or cancel any or all aspects relative to the Deal Registration initiative, at any time, without prior notice. In the event of alterations or cancellations, Approved Opportunities for which You have already received a Quote Letter, will not be affected, unless you receive a new Quote Letter with updated terms.

7.     Audit and Offsetting. Intel reserves the right to audit and verify all claim requests and request additional proof of performance documentation.  The provision of benefits is at the discretion of Intel and is based on the requirements outlined in these Terms and Conditions.  Without prejudice to any right or remedy available to Intel under these Terms and Conditions, at law or otherwise, Intel will have the right at any time to set off any liability of Company to Intel resulting from failure to comply with any Deal Registration initiative requirements, submission of inaccurate information to Intel, or abuse of the program, against any liability of Intel to You (including, without limitation, any rebate due to You from Intel), and irrespective of the currency of its denomination, unless such set off is prohibited under applicable local law. If the liabilities to be set off are expressed in different currencies, Intel may convert either liability at a market rate of exchange for the purpose of set off. For the purposes of this sub-Section 3.2 only: (i) “Intel” means the Intel legal entity entering into these Terms and Conditions, its direct and indirect subsidiaries, its ultimate parent company and the latter’s direct and indirect subsidiaries; (ii) “Company” means the Company legal entity entering into these Terms and Conditions, its direct and indirect subsidiaries, its ultimate parent company and the latter’s direct and indirect subsidiaries.

8.    Password. You are required to keep Your System password secure and confidential and use it only for Your authorized access to the System. You are solely responsible for all activities that occur with Your password. You agree to notify Intel immediately of any actual or suspected unauthorized use of Your password. Intel is not responsible for any consequences that result from any unauthorized use of Your password.

9.     Legal Compliance. You will fulfill any and all Approved Opportunity in compliance with any applicable law, regulation and generally accepted code of conduct in the execution territory. This includes determining whether the Approved Opportunity can actually be carried out at all in compliance with applicable law or regulation.

10.    Termination. Intel may terminate Your use of the System, and these Terms and Conditions, at any time and for any reason by providing You notice of termination at least fourteen (14) days prior to the effective date of the termination. You may terminate Your use of the System, and Your agreement to these Terms and Conditions at any time by providing written notice to Intel.  Upon termination, all rights and benefits granted to You under these Terms and Conditions, will cease immediately, and You will immediately comply with all termination obligations specified in these Terms and Conditions and other applicable notices. If Intel determines, in its sole discretion, that you have not complied with either these Terms and Conditions or those of the applicable Quote Letter, Intel may withhold or recall benefits provided to you and may terminate Your use of the System, and these Terms and Conditions, immediately upon notice to You.
